units.source_text: 我和汉子回到了我的房间。

en.t: The man and I returned to my room.

units.source_text: 不多久，姑娘到旅馆的庭院里观赏菊圃来了。

en.t: Before long, the girl came to the inn's garden to look at the chrysanthemum beds.
The dancer walked to the middle of the bridge.

units.source_text: 四十岁的女人走出公共浴场，看见了她们两人。

en.t: The forty-year-old woman came out of the public bathhouse and saw the two of them.

units.source_text: 舞女紧缩肩膀，笑了笑，让人看起来像是在说：要挨骂的，该回去啦。

en.t: The dancer hunched her shoulders and smiled a little, as if to say, I will be scolded, so I should go back now.

units.source_text: 四十岁的女人来到桥边扬声喊道：

en.t: The forty-year-old woman came to the side of the bridge and called out loudly:
